title: Graphene oxide conformally wrapped FeOOH/graphite composite anodes for lithium-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3404-3411
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00202H, Paper
Periyasamy Anushkkaran, Yu Lim Lee, Seong Hui Kim, Su Hyeon Ahn, Du Hyun Lim, Hyun Gyu Kim, Jum Suk Jang
Graphene oxide-encapsulated graphite/FeOOH composite anodes were fabricated to improve the capacity and stability of FeOOH anodes for Li-ion batteries.
